title: Implement POST /api/batches Next.js API route
description: Create the API route for creating a new batch. Validates input, inserts the batch record, and returns the created batch.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/batches accepts { name, industry } JSON body
Returns 201 with created batch object on success
Returns 400 if name or industry is missing
Batch is persisted to the DB via repository
Verify with curl or Playwright API test

steps.details: Export async POST handler. Parse body, validate name and industry are non-empty strings. Call `createBatch({ name, industry })` from repository. Return NextResponse.json(batch, { status: 201 }).
Wrap in try/catch. Return 400 for validation errors, 500 for unexpected errors with a JSON error body { error: string }.
Run: `curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/batches -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"Test Batch","industry":"roofing"}'`. Verify 201 response with batch data.
